title: Model Stores and Website Experiences
readerIntent: Model websites, Stores, and catalogs for several customer experiences.
priorKnowledge: Understand Storefront Site, Store, CMS, Product, and trusted context.
owner: Storefront resolution plus referenced capability owners
summary: Sites define hostname experience context; Stores define commercial context; CMS and Product own their catalogs.

sections.heading: Patterns
items: One enterprise, two Sites, two Stores, and separate Apparel/Electronics content and product catalogs.
One Site serving several Stores under explicit routing/context policy.
Several host aliases resolving to one Site.
Physical Store related to a digital Site and optional pickup warehouses.

sections.heading: Rules
items: A Site references catalogs but does not duplicate their ownership.
Context handles are opaque, bounded, audience-specific, and tenant-safe.
Test aliases, inactive records, wrong audience, cross-tenant references, cache invalidation, and resizing/localization only in clients.
